baselineRegression.method: Ten targeted cases from final tests against isolated turn-start SetupWizard, Settings and local_models copies. Eight failed; two invalid URL rejection cases already passed. Parameterized failures are not eight independent defects.

connectionTestEquivalence.description: Actual old three functions versus the final shared function: identical requests, normalized results, strict ok:true validation and errors across 3 test kinds x 4 HTTP statuses x 8 payload/transport outcomes.

changes: SetupWizard and LocalLLMProviderRow share one local configuration hook for load/probe/filtering and request ownership. URL drafts, unmounts and superseding requests invalidate old responses. Initial wizard probes omit an explicit URL and follow durable server configuration.

Removed browser endpoint URL reads/writes, duplicate address/detection states, stale selection-error effect, saved-state timer, endpoint/storageKey props and two pass-through local provider wrappers. Persisted browser model choices remain unchanged.

Backend records endpoint revisions, discards superseded probe health writes including A-to-B-to-A switches, and scopes matching readiness deduplication to endpoint revision and requested model. Different models at the same endpoint still probe independently.
Explicit endpoint changes reset the old catalogue before probing. Invalid or strict-privacy-forbidden addresses are rejected before mutation. Same-address offline probes retain their prior catalogue.
Queued inference for a superseded endpoint does not run. Already-running old inference may finish but cannot update the new endpoint health, including switching back to the original address.
Local health and runtime refresh tolerate superseded probes and read current durable provider state after waiting, without passing captured URLs back as configuration changes.

LLM, configured-route and vision test request helpers consolidated into runModelConnectionTest. All existing test entry points, payloads, credentials, strict ok:true success rule, returned model/latency normalization and error text preserved.
limitations: No real local/cloud model calls, native UI/visual acceptance, latency benchmark or full-suite rerun. HTTP fixtures, component tests and isolated backend databases only.

Address selection is ordered by acceptance in this backend process. No multi-client transaction/versioned API or rollback of an already accepted configuration write is claimed. Aborting a client request does not undo backend writes.
An already-running inference may still finish against the original address; only queued stale execution and obsolete health writes are blocked.

Only local endpoint configuration was unified. Concurrent model preference saves, preference-row draft rollback and late connection-test labels remain separate open areas, along with personal-case cache account isolation and case keystroke write coalescing.
Backend build was reused after unchanged backend fingerprints were checked; frontend lint/builds reran after the final Settings helper consolidation. No commit, push or client restart.
